summary: Narrow UQ campus lane under trees with no room to pull off.
reasons: Loading zone and no-stopping signs nearby

drivers.seclusion: Surrounded by university buildings; busy campus foot traffic, no dwellings.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow lane with a few cars parked tight along it; no clear pull-off beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Campus service route with pedestrian crossing at the north end.
drivers.convention: Signed loading zones, no stopping and metered parking area; not an overnight spot.

flags: Loading zone and no-stopping signs within 8 m
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy shades the lane, mainly from the east and north.

best_section.where: Campbell Road campus lane beside Duhig Tower, St Lucia
